items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date: 05.11.2025 (a Wednesday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed). This is the last day the documents must be submitted; failure risks loss of benefits from December per §§ 60, 66 SGB I.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Änderungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 15.10.2025, posted by an authority (social law, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 19.10.2025 (this day does not shift for social-law deemed delivery). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later is Wed 19.11.2025. That day is a public holiday (Buß- und Bettag) in Sachsen, so per § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day, Thu 20.11.2025.
